cases.prompt: We are rolling out the Northwind Billing Assistant to billing, finance and tech staff. Who needs what AI training, how many hours is that, and does this cover EU AI Act Article 4?
expected: Asks for (or builds from) a population CSV with role, headcount, exposure, proficiency and business unit
Runs scripts/adoption_plan.py; overseers always get the human-oversight module
Uses the amended Article 4 wording (support the development of AI literacy; no individual level guaranteed) and says it is not a legal determination
Does not invent KPI targets; missing ones are TBD for the Change lead

cases.prompt: Build the AI literacy and adoption plan for the attached Northwind Billing Assistant population, waves and targets.
expected: 221 people, 812.5 training hours; Customer Operations wave 2 carries 558 hours; AIL-02 has 166 seats

contains:"| AIL-02 | Prompting and checking outputs for your tasks | 2 | 2 | hands-on lab | user/operator | — | 166 | 332 |"
